AI Threatens Australian Cartooning and Publishing Industries

AI-generated illustrations are causing concern among Australian cartoonists, with one artist stating the industry is "shrinking dramatically." Simultaneously, AI publishing scams are targeting Australian authors. These developments raise fears about the future of creative professions in the country.
